notes.title: Huge Update - Version 2.0 - New Languages, improved gameplay +more
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36142644/b30bfedd3982f40f6be2a6046c512e8fe35783e4.gif
Hello folks, I'm here with my newest update, time for SHAPESHOOTER! For this game I added new languages and improved gameplay aspects aswell!
New Languages
Following my effort to make my games more accessible I've added 8 new languages:
 Portuguese - BR
 Spanish
 Japanese
 Russian
 Simplified Chinese
 Traditional Chinese
 Korean
 German
Gameplay Improvements
 Receiving damage now gives the player 2 seconds of invulnerability, and everything does the same amount damage to the player. (So now, if the player get stuck in a laser, it will not die instantaneously)
 Checkpoints now store the ammo of the player
 Ammo pickup now scrolls betwen weapons the player own 
Quality of Life improvements
 Rumble funcion for the controller
 Aim assist (that can be disabled)
 Toggle between fullscreen and borderles windowed
 Possibility to reset progress and achievements
Balancing 
 Increased the time to complete all stages by about 30%
Graphics
 New background for the main menu

I would like to ask you guys to check on the game I'm working, Burning Skies wich will be released this year, and if you like it, please wishlist it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1915690/Burning_Skies/

And join my discord Server for news and updates before everyone else:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36142644/b77b2f0b3688bfda9a9af8483e459cf3a1dfd1f7.gif

Thank you!
Paulo

notes.title: Burning Skies Arcade - Demo Update

Hello folks, based on your feedback I've worked for the last weeks, on an update for the Burning Skies Arcade Demo, here's what changed:

Improvements/Fetures
 Highscore
 Saving the settings and Hiscore
 A little tutorial at the beggining of the demo
 Feedback when the player picks a power up
 Ajusted audio mastering
New Content
 New Range Power Up
Balancing
 Adjusted the space between projectiles on one of the boss's attacks
Bugfixes
- Wall creation with missing parts
- Audio didn't set to zero
- Glitch when music interlapping
- glitch engine sfx interlapping
- when pausing at the beggining the menu whould not show up
 
Check the free demo here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2290190/Burning_Skies_Arcade/

As aways, thanks for your support, and please join our discord and tell me what do you think of this new update.

notes.title: Shapeshooter Ver 1.03
notes.content:
Hello friends, small update available now:

 Fixed a bug where sometimes shooting with the buckshot it could crash the game;

 Fixed a bug where if the player dies behind the checkpoint, the tank would not move to the checkpoint position

 Fixed a bug where sometimes destroying the SQUARE enemy cound crash the game.

 Fixed a bug where if the player shot an enemy very close to it, the shot color would not matter. 

 Fixed a bug where if the player connect the controller after the game had started, it would cause the turret to aim on a fixed direction

 Now if the controller is disconnected when playing the game would pause. 

 Fixed a bug where the screen would shake indefinitely on the stage 2-2 if the player stops the tank. 

If you have any feedback, please join our discord server for better comunication. 

discord.nukgames.com

Thanks for the support. 
Paulo
